scope: local matched-model conditional design; normalized controls; not nonlinear recovery or hardware admission
coordinate_status: normalized synthetic model controls; not certified hardware DAC commands

candidate_search.distribution: independent uniform in the Branch-B CL1/CL3/C-mini normalized-control safe box
candidate_search.selection: four-start exhaustive minimax coordinate exchange; minimize maximum profiled scaled target standard uncertainty
candidate_search.warning: The selection is nominal-truth local and is not robust D-optimality over a truth envelope.
candidate_search.integrated_larmor_naming: The inherited Branch-B affine_q_per_m key is legacy naming: hard_edge_solenoid_matrix uses the dimensionless integrated Larmor strength q=K*L.

astigmatic_tag_contract.required_plane: upstream of CL1 and therefore upstream of every fitted condenser lens; otherwise include the measured stigmator plane and its quadrupole/transport map, and assign no sensitivity to lenses upstream of that plane
astigmatic_tag_contract.fitted_shared_quantities: incident covariance, ellipticity, and an unknown common orientation offset
astigmatic_tag_contract.used_information: state-relative ellipse orientation and covariance only
astigmatic_tag_contract.repeatability_requirement: the same tagged source state must be reproducible over the complete acquisition, with interleaved reference and reverse-approach repeats

nuisance_contract.note: Two nuisance-only gauges remain. The target projection uses the normalized nuisance column space.

frame_accounting.rule: Count 184 only when the spatial ellipse and tag angle are extracted from one image and their complete joint bootstrap covariance is used. Otherwise use the conservative 232-frame count.

fisher_audit.warning: The 1% pass has no design margin and is conditional on every declared summary noise and scale prior.

astigmatic_tag_plane_and_repeatability.requirement: demonstrate that the deliberate astigmatism is introduced upstream of CL1, or certify and fit its actual plane/map; verify interleaved orientation/ellipticity repeatability at the declared covariance

si_111_reciprocal_radius_detector_sampli.requirement: measured indexed Si {111} radius between 3 and 96 pixels with at least two non-collinear indexed vectors

native_diffraction_camera_length.requirement: a native NEOARM diffraction mode with measured effective camera length near 0.4 m is reachable and repeatable at every selected condenser state

detector_mtf_and_nyquist.requirement: minor-axis RMS at least 1.5 times the measured MTF sigma and the full fitted support inside the detector

disc_edge_snr.requirement: dense bootstrap covariance demonstrates <=0.002 standard uncertainty for every retained log-width/correlation summary and <=0.001 rad for tag orientation

saturation_and_deadtime.requirement: no saturated pixels and detector deadtime/gain correction validated over the complete selected dose range

disc_overlap_and_deblending.requirement: indexed discs remain separable and deblending bias is below 0.2 experimental standard deviations

centered_c_aperture_images.status: fail_closed_reconnaissance_only; not part of the selected Fisher matrix
centered_c_aperture_images.model: optimistic centered anisotropic-Gaussian image fit using log sigma_x/a, log sigma_y/a, correlation_xy, and exact circular-aperture log throughput with an aperture-out dose reference
centered_c_aperture_images.conclusion: Useful CL1/CL3 reconnaissance under partial clipping, but not a replacement for translated aperture-edge anchoring. The C aperture is upstream of C-mini, so this image has exactly zero C-mini action; indexed-Si or independently validated phase diversity remains necessary.

signed_phase_diversity.status: fail_closed_reconnaissance_only; not part of the selected Fisher matrix
signed_phase_diversity.model: sample spatial ellipses at calibrated signed free-space diversity, with a shared 0.002 log-defocus-scale prior
signed_phase_diversity.conclusion: The rows retain formal rank twelve but do not constrain the dominant CL1-length/shared-scale direction enough to meet one percent with 0.2 percent scale priors. Dimensionless position-angle correlations are nearly redundant; known signed diversity must be validated before any such rows are admitted.

hardware_admission.reason: Every detector-feasibility gate requires measured evidence; repeated-state independence and the local matched hard-edge model are unverified.
